notes: AMD publishes no state-level or country-level jobs data. Footprint by country is property and equipment, net, from the FY2024 10-K (U.S., Singapore, Canada, India, Ireland, China incl. Hong Kong, other). Employees by region come from AMD's online Corporate Responsibility data tables (the page now shows 2022–2025; the 2024 column is used and matches the 10-K's ~28,000). Regions are not defined by country list. The 10-K says AMD has about 6 million square feet worldwide but gives no square footage by site. No taxes-by-country report was found (only a UK tax strategy page).
